title: Liability Limit on Signed Lost or Stolen Card Claims, Paystride Visa Payroll Card Premier and Elite
content:
On a signed lost or stolen card claim of the Paystride Visa Payroll Card Premier or Elite plan, the liability limit follows the claimed transaction and the loss report.

**The loss report.** The loss counts as reported on the date of the account's single lost or stolen replacement order placed on or after the loss date, among its orders of the last 12 months. The report is late when it came more than 2 business days after the loss date. Business days are Monday through Friday excluding Federal Reserve holidays, counted from the day after the earlier date through the later one.

**The limit.**

| Claimed transaction and report | Liability limit |
|---|---|
| a purchase, on a plan applying Visa Zero Liability (both plans apply it) | 0.00 |
| otherwise, the report came more than 2 business days after the loss date | 500.00 |
| otherwise | 50.00 |

No transfer on such a claim is charged to the cardholder in full; the limit is always one of the three figures above.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical; no holiday in the period)

- Loss date on a Monday, replacement ordered on the Wednesday: 2 business days, not late, so an ATM withdrawal claim has a limit of 50.00.
- The same loss with the replacement ordered on the Thursday: 3 business days, late, so the limit is 500.00.
- A purchase claim from either loss has a limit of 0.00.
- Loss date on a Friday, replacement ordered on the following Tuesday: Monday and Tuesday are 2 business days, not late.
